stem: A researcher selected 1,000 adults at random from all adults in a country and asked how many hours they usually sleep each night. Each adult also took a short concentration test. Adults who usually sleep at least 7 hours had a higher average test score than adults who usually sleep less. Which of the following statements is (are) supported by the study? I. Among adults in the country, sleeping at least 7 hours is associated with higher concentration test scores. II. For adults in the country, sleeping at least 7 hours causes higher concentration test scores. III. Each adult in the sample who sleeps at least 7 hours scored higher than each adult in the sample who sleeps less.
solution: Statement I: the adults were a random sample of the country's adults, and the study found an association, so I is supported.
Statement II: the adults chose their own sleep habits (no random assignment), so a causal claim is not supported.
Statement III: a higher average for one group does not mean every member of that group scored higher than every member of the other group.

explanation.A: Incorrect. Statements II and III are not supported.
explanation.B: Correct. Only the generalized association (I) is supported.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Statement II is a causal claim, which needs random assignment; statement I is the one that is supported.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Statement III confuses a difference in averages with a difference for every individual.
